verdicts.explanation: The abstract reports ~0.03 S/m at 423 K for Na2Ni2TeO6 from impedance spectroscopy in this work, and Ea = 0.58 eV is the T > 383 K fit. The 900 C annealing, ~90% density, and solid-state synthesis all match the paper; the 149.85 C conversion is arithmetic from 423 K.

The introduction explicitly quotes ~0.0008-0.0034 S/m at room temperature for Na2Ni2TeO6 from refs 6 and 9, so literature_cited is the correct origin. All secondary fields are null, which is appropriate for a cited value.
